# Mobile-device groups

Jamf Pro smart and static **mobile-device** groups via the v2 JSON API (`/api/v2/mobile-device-groups/…`). Smart groups have criteria; static groups have explicit membership. These are separate from computer [groups](/docs/docs/smart-groups) and Platform [device groups](/docs/docs/device-groups).

## Agent rules

- Membership rows may return IDs only (empty name/serial) depending on the Jamf version.
- Use `mobile_smart_group_set_criteria` for criteria edits; do not PUT hand-built JSON unless you fetched it first.

## Facts

- List: `mobile_smart_groups(...)` / `mobile_static_groups(...)` · `buddy mobile-group list smart|static`
- Load one: `mobile_smart_group(id=…|name=…)` / `mobile_static_group(…)` · `buddy mobile-group get <group-id>` — CLI tries smart, then static
- Criteria: `mobile_smart_group_criteria` / `mobile_smart_group_set_criteria` · `buddy mobile-group smart criteria|set-criteria` — Same criteria shape as computer smart groups
- Members: `mobile_smart_group_devices` / `mobile_static_group_devices` · `buddy mobile-group smart|static members`
- Static membership: `mobile_static_group_add_devices` / `_remove_devices` / `_set_devices` · `buddy mobile-group static add|remove|set` — Read-modify-write
- Create / delete: `mobile_smart_group_create` / `mobile_static_group_create` / `*_delete` · `buddy mobile-group create|delete smart|static`
- Smart criteria use the same `{name, priority, andOr, searchType, value}` shape as computer smart groups.
- Static membership mutates are read-modify-write on the group's assignments array.
- Do not mix with computer `smart_group*` / `static_group*` builtins or Platform `device_group*`.

## Examples

```python
def main():
    return mobile_smart_groups(filter="iPad")
```

```python
def main():
    gid = mobile_smart_groups(filter="Latest iOS")[0]["id"]
    crit = mobile_smart_group_criteria(id = gid)
    for c in crit:
        if "OS Version" in c["name"]:
            c["value"] = "18.0"
    mobile_smart_group_set_criteria(id = gid, criteria = crit)
```
